text: {"lessons":["My account fell for several periods despite making few trades, so holding without a plan does not eliminate risk; I should review whether my overall stock exposure suits retirement needs.","Selling after large declines can reduce exposure, but I should base decisions on future risk and my financial plan—not just on whether a price is below my average cost.","A small recovery after the downturn did not erase the earlier losses, reminding me to prioritize a steady, manageable level of risk over trying to time short-term moves."]}
